payload.note: BOOTSTRAP subset: top canonical gates only, not the full MANDATORY chain (P2 encodes the full chain).

gates.description: Every instruction/chat/prompt/skill/response carries a code-parsable representation per QNFO.CODEPARSE.SCOPE.v1 (dual-representation).
All output in English; translate non-English sources.
Local-fault-first: external platform errors are rare; exhaust local recovery before external attribution.
Before external attribution, run a change audit of own recent actions on the failing component.
Disagree with evidence, seek disconfirmation, expose failure modes, label uncertainty.
100% cloud infrastructure; fully autonomous user-free self-operation, self-audit, self-correction, self-improvement.
7 prompt stores byte-identical + header==footer==title + 11/11 CMD templates + guard exits 0 after every dual-write.
All instructions and code Lamport structured-proof-like: hierarchical WHAT/WHY/SCOPE, PROOF/BY connectors, function=lemma with contract.
Framework/governance records carry claim-sheet fields (claim/evidence/confidence/status) on their locked claims.
Every closeout resolves every deferred item: execute, dated schedule, guard, or delete-with-rationale.
Local scheduler registry must equal the canonical front-end set; scheduler-guard.py exit 0.
Every worker carries VERSION via /health + self-doc header + canonical repo with byte-matching deployed-current.
Root-cause to mechanism, fix with read-back, permanent guard, canonical-case documentation, guard exits 0.
No local project files; code in git, data in R2/D1/Vectorize.
Personal twin never calls the QNFO records oracle; research gateway never binds personal stores.
Test/verification payloads never go to real external recipients; own mailboxes only.
Every done claim requires a same-turn tool call (file read-back, exit code, DB query, verifier run).
